trust_decision.summary: Client-side: the debug exception page's single global tippy.js init decides whether tooltip text from data-tippy-content (request URL, headers, routing, SQL with interpolated bindings) is rendered as HTML; it is hard-coded allowHTML:true, so Blade's attribute escaping is undone in the DOM.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'Debug Page Information'; an engineer greps the renderer's Blade components for user-controlled values (headers/URL) shown in tooltips, then follows data-tippy-content to scripts.js.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP: any request whose exception is rendered by Renderer::render with app.debug on (src/Illuminate/Foundation/Exceptions/Handler.php:878-879)
fix_sites.module_kind: frontend JS source (tooltip init, split into text and html selectors, fix.diff:84-102)

fix_sites.entry_point: Same HTTP exception page; this built bundle is what is actually inlined into the page (src/Illuminate/Foundation/Exceptions/Renderer/Renderer.php:128-129)
Same HTTP exception page, stack frame rows (src/Illuminate/Foundation/resources/exceptions/renderer/components/frame.blade.php:32)
fix_sites.module_kind: Blade view component (opt-in to HTML tooltip, fix.diff:13-14)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: dist/scripts.js is a generated minified bundle ('don't edit build output'), so a solver edits only scripts.js and never rebuilds, leaving the runtime page unchanged.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what:
Multiline SQL tooltip relies on HTML: query.blade.php feeds nl2br($sql) to the tooltip and the pinned test asserts the
survives; keeping HTML for queries to preserve line breaks reopens XSS through interpolated bindings, while the frame-source tooltip is intentionally kept HTML.

O6_input_shapes: SQL text with string bindings interpolated in quotes

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Move the SQL tooltip to an HTML-enabled selector to keep nl2br line breaks, with bindings interpolated unescaped
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The pinned tests show maintainers want multiline query tooltips; an HTML opt-in for that single component is a natural maintainer choice (HOW-type: coupled legit value next to hidden one).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Tooltip on route parameter JSON values via an HTML-enabled attribute
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Neighbouring component of the same panel; adding a tooltip like routing.blade.php's would be routine (WHERE-type, extra only).

O9_family: XSS (CWE-80): client-side HTML rendering of escaped attribute text via tooltip library option

O10_build.toolchain: composer + phpunit/orchestra testbench; node >=22.19 + vite to rebuild dist (src/Illuminate/Foundation/resources/exceptions/renderer/package.json:4-10)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/Integration/Foundation/Exceptions/RenderBladeFilesTest.php (string assertions on rendered Blade HTML only; no DOM/JS execution test exists)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Flip allowHTML to false in scripts.js only (no dist rebuild), or double-escape the header value in request-header.blade.php alone.

out_of_scope_notes: request-url.blade.php:8 places fullUrl() inside a single-quoted JS string in an Alpine x-data attribute with HTML escaping only; not part of this advisory's tooltip protection.
Debug page is only served with app.debug enabled (Handler.php:876-885).
unverified: Behavioural verification of the real flaw needs a DOM/JS runtime (headless browser or jsdom running dist/scripts.js); PHP-level tests cannot distinguish fixed from unfixed, since the server HTML is identical before and after the scripts.js change. Not flagged needs_gpu_kernel_gui because headless suffices, but this is the main build risk.
Several valid fix strategies (client option flip vs server-side double escaping) complicate hidden-test design.
